title: Special Delivery: The Pedalling Pelican
description: A white pelican leans into the handlebars of a cherry-red seaside bicycle, its enormous golden bill and orange throat pouch leading the way. Aqua-rimmed wheels, alternating webbed feet, swept feathered wings, a cycling cap and a rear basket of fish complete the character. A discreet kickstand supports the freestanding model.
